requirements.description: RequestVote RPC must reject candidates whose log is less up-to-date than the voter's log (compare last log term first, then last log index)
requirements.evidence: handle_request_vote (L127-136): log_ok 先比较 candidate 的 last_log_term > 本节点 last_log_term，相等时再比较 last_log_index >= 本节点 last_log_index（符合 Raft §5.4.1）。同时 voted_for 检查也在位（L133-134）。日志不够新的候选者会被拒绝（返回 vote_granted=False）。

requirements.description: AppendEntries RPC must check prevLogIndex and prevLogTerm before appending entries (reject if the follower's log doesn't match at that position)
requirements.evidence: handle_append_entries (L158-165): 当 prev_log_index > 0 时，(a) 若 follower 日志不够长则拒绝；(b) 若 term_at(prev_log_index) != prev_log_term 则拒绝并截断冲突日志。只有通过一致性检查后才进入条目追加（L167-174），逐条比对 term 处理冲突。

requirements.description: Leaders must only commit log entries from their current term (never commit entries from previous terms by counting replicas alone)
requirements.evidence: _try_commit (L235-236): 新增守卫条件 `if self.log.term_at(n) != self.current_term: continue`。只有当前任期的条目才通过副本计数直接提交。旧任期条目通过 Log Matching Property 在当前任期条目推进 commit_index 时被间接提交（Raft §5.4.2）。

requirements.description: All tests must pass: pytest tests/
requirements.evidence: Executor1 报告 15/15 全部通过：test_commit.py (3), test_election.py (3), test_partition.py (2), test_replication.py (4), test_safety.py (3)。覆盖选举安全、日志复制、分区恢复、状态机安全等场景。

requirements.description: Only fix consensus logic in raft/node.py; do not change network simulation or message format
requirements.evidence: messages.py 明确标注 'Do not modify this file'，log.py 保持原样，改动仅限 node.py 的三个 handler：handle_request_vote、handle_append_entries、_try_commit。
